findings.evidence: `Expansion/Laurent/Basic.lean:59` defines `laurentSeriesExpansion`, and lines 152–180 define `residue`, its coefficient formula, regularity result, and uniformizer-power formula. By `laurentSeriesExpansion_apply` (lines 64–66), the new `laurentCoeff_apply` is the same coefficient projection, so `residueAtUniformizer` is extensionally the existing `residue`.
findings.fix: Keep the genuinely new completion-level maps, but state function-field coefficient results via `(P.laurentSeriesExpansion hP ht z).coeff n` and reuse `P.residue`; add only missing lemmas to the canonical Laurent/Basic API.
findings.issue: `laurentCoeff` and the entire `residueAtUniformizer` suite duplicate the function-field API already provided by `laurentSeriesExpansion` and `residue`.

summary: The function-field coefficient and residue layer duplicates the existing canonical Laurent-expansion API instead of extending it.
